title: Code and frozen results for: Deconfounding transductive population-graph learning in multisite fMRI - tracing high cohort accuracy to same-site supervision
description: Reproducibility software and frozen analysis artifacts for the study "Deconfounding transductive population-graph learning in multisite fMRI: tracing high cohort accuracy to same-site supervision". Contains the deterministic harness, the frozen 10-fold split manifest, the result registry (the single numeric source for every reported value), per-subject out-of-fold predictions for all reported conditions including leave-one-site-out re-runs for two preprocessing pipelines, derived statistics, and the registry-schema and numeric audits. No primary imaging data are redistributed.
